# Q&A Log — Standards Alignment (Data/Metadata)
# Append-only. Do not edit past entries; add new dated entries instead.

## 2026-09-22 — Q0.1: Which standards form the reference panel for Data/Metadata?

**Context:** Same process used for all three prior layers. This layer is
also where DAMA-DMBOK (flagged as a candidate standard since the very
start of this framework's design conversation) and the unresolved
Data-sensitivity Risk Tier factor (carried by Infrastructure, Networking,
and System Architecture) both become directly relevant.

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable.

**Drafted:** DAMA-DMBOK, ISO/IEC 11179, ISO 8000, DCAT, DCMI, FAIR Data
Principles, NIST SP 800-60, NIST FIPS 199 (reused), ISO/IEC 27001 Annex
A.5. Schema.org noted separately as a vocabulary, not a formal standard.
GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS noted as deferred regulatory candidates,
not assumed for a generalized framework.

**Status:** Pending explicit review — same pattern as all three prior
layers' initial standards panels.
